SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.engineering.safety

Class PhysicalInventorySafeguardingPidBridge

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.safety.PhysicalInventorySafeguardingPidBridge
public final class PhysicalInventorySafeguardingPidBridge extends Object
Materializes physical-inventory safeguarding proposals into the existing governed P&ID and engineering-requirement contracts.

The bridge adds no approval, SIL target, voting architecture or safety credit. It preserves the exact calculated range, alarm/trip, response-budget, physical-inventory and provenance values in P&ID attributes so existing DEXPI/package exporters can carry them forward.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
